user.title: Site
user.description: Wi-Fi and the device login password are entered here and are not shipped with the integration. The login username is always admin. Leave the password blank and new devices stay open, with no login. It is applied when a new or factory device is adopted. Store it in a password manager: a lost password needs a factory reset. Timezone is optional and is pre-filled from this Home Assistant instance ({ha_timezone}). Clear it to send no zone.

data_description.site_name: A label for this Shelly Installer entry, shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.wifi_ssid: 2.4 GHz network. WPA3-only and 5 GHz-only networks will not join.
data_description.wifi_password: Stored on this config entry. It is not written to logs or diagnostics.
data_description.fleet_password: Password for the Shelly local web page and API. Username is always admin. Shelly Installer saves it into the Shelly integration so Home Assistant stays connected. Leave blank for no login.
data_description.timezone: Optional. An IANA tz database name, case-sensitive, Region/City, for example Australia/Melbourne, Australia/Sydney, or Europe/London. Abbreviations such as AEDT and offsets such as UTC+11 are not accepted. This sets the device clock zone for on-device schedules and sunrise/sunset. It matters more when Shelly Cloud is off, because the device will not auto-detect a zone. Leave it blank and no location.tz is sent.

behaviour.title: Provisioning behaviour
behaviour.description: These are generic choices, not a site profile. Home Assistant's Shelly flow always turns the access point and Bluetooth RPC off after Wi-Fi provisioning. Uncheck those boxes to turn them back on afterwards. The Bluetooth scanner is separate and stays available for the proxy. Auto-adopt nearby new Shellies is on by default. It does nothing while Only provision devices in the allowlist is on. Turn that option off to adopt every factory-new Shelly in range, including a neighbour's.

data.update_firmware: Update to stable firmware after adoption
data.require_allowlist: Only provision devices in the allowlist
data.ble_scanner_mode: Bluetooth scanner mode on each adopted Shelly

data_description.disable_ble_rpc: Bluetooth RPC is the setup channel. The advertisement proxy keeps working with RPC off.
data_description.auto_adopt: On, and with Only provision the allowlist off, a factory-new Shelly with no login and an open setup window is adopted even if it is not on the list.
data_description.require_allowlist: While this is on, auto-adopt leaves devices that are not on the list alone. Turn it off only to adopt every factory-new Shelly in range, including a neighbour's.
data_description.ble_scanner_mode: Active asks nearby devices for full advertisements. Shelly proxies cannot open GATT connections.
data_description.concurrency: Keep this within the free connection slots of your connectable Bluetooth proxies. 2 is a safe start.
data_description.provisioning_minutes: How long the provisioning switch stays on. This is not the device's 15-minute setup window.
data_description.default_output_type: Applied to every switch channel during adoption and profile apply, unless you set that channel yourself. Light makes the core Shelly integration create a light. This does not reboot the device.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi
wifi.description: Leave the Wi-Fi password blank to keep the one already stored on this entry.

security.title: Security and timezone
security.description: A new device login password is stored for later. Changing it here does not re-key any device. Leave the box blank to keep the stored password. Devices that already have a login are never changed, and Home Assistant keeps the password already stored for them. Leave the timezone blank to keep the stored zone. Tick Clear timezone to store no zone, so location.tz is not sent. A new Region/City name replaces the stored zone.

data_description.fleet_password: Local web page and API password. Username is always admin. Stored only. Keep a copy in your password manager. A lost password needs a factory reset.

secure.title: Secure profile
secure.description: Checklist for Secure devices. Typing a password here only stores it. It does not re-key devices. Secure devices and Apply profile set this login only on devices that have no password. Devices that already have a password are left unchanged, and Home Assistant keeps the password already stored for them.

data.secure_rotate_password: Set the device login when a device has none

data_description.fleet_password: Stored for devices that have no login. Does not replace a password a device already has.
data_description.secure_rotate_password: Shelly.SetAuth with username admin, only when the device has no login.
data_description.secure_disable_ble_rpc: Bluetooth itself stays on so an enabled scanner proxy keeps working.
data_description.secure_firmware_manual: Gen2+ has no auto-update switch. This skips Shelly.Update. Cloud push stops when cloud is off.
data_description.secure_restrict_web_ui: Turns off mDNS discovery. The web page still asks for the device login when a password is set.

inputs.title: Input profile
inputs.description: Applied to every channel when you adopt a device or run Apply profile. Turn the profile on or the fields are ignored. Per-device rows in the allowlist override these.

data_description.input_mode: Detached leaves the physical input independent of the relay or dimmer output. Momentary on a dimmer is sent as dim, because Light has no momentary mode.

outputs.title: Output profile
outputs.description: Power-on state and auto on/off timers. Match input applies to switches. Toggle applies to dimmers. A value the model rejects is skipped. Default output type is light, so switch outputs show as lights in Home Assistant unless you set a channel yourself.

dimmers.title: Dimmer profile
dimmers.description: Fade rate is button_fade_rate (1 slow, 5 fast). Transition duration is the verified ramp, in seconds, from 0% to 100%. Separate up and down ramps are sent only when the device already exposes those fields. Power-on brightness is sent only when the component config already has a brightness field for it.

provisioning.title: Provisioning
provisioning.description: Auto-adopt is ignored while Only provision the allowlist is on. With the allowlist option off, a factory-new Shelly in range can be adopted, including a neighbour's.

data.update_firmware: Update to stable firmware after adoption
data.require_allowlist: Only provision devices in the allowlist
data.ble_scanner_mode: Bluetooth scanner mode on each adopted Shelly
data.batch_output_type: Output type for auto-adopt and Find my Shelly

data_description.batch_output_type: One type for every device those batch adds list. It is stored on the device and is not replaced by a later change of the site default. The device is not rebooted.

allowlist.title: Import allowlist
allowlist.description: shelly_bulk/devices.csv is created on setup when it is missing, and an existing file is never overwritten. A header with no devices imports an empty list. Replace swaps the stored list. Leave replace off to merge.

add_device.title: Add device
add_device.description: Appends one Shelly to shelly_bulk/devices.csv and the allowlist. A MAC that is already listed is left as you edited it. Output type is filled from the site default. If this model has profiles, the mode is applied before the name and the device restarts once. The choice is kept, so a later site default does not overwrite it.

data_description.mac: 12 hex digits, with or without colons.
data_description.name: Optional. Leave blank and fill it in later.
data_description.output_type: Consumption type for the first switch. Light makes the core Shelly integration create a light.
data_description.output_type_2: Used when the device has a second switch. Leave it the same as channel 1 when there is only one.
data_description.profile: Don't set unless the model lists profiles, such as switch or cover on a 2PM. Applied before the name. The device restarts once.

edit_device.title: Edit a device
edit_device.description: Pick an adopted Shelly. The next form is filled with the settings read from that device.

edit_fields.title: Device settings
edit_fields.description: Only settings this model reports are shown. Saving writes them back and checks the device returned the same value. Fields that were not accepted: {details}.

copy_settings.title: Copy settings to other devices
copy_settings.description: Choose a group. The change runs in the background. Don't copy leaves the edit on this device only.

bulk_change.title: Bulk change settings
bulk_change.description: Choose devices by group. You confirm how many will change before any device is touched.

device_type.title: Device type
device_type.description: Choose the devices. The next step sets the consumption type, and the profile only when you confirm the reboot.

device_type_form.title: Device type
device_type_form.description: Consumption type is saved on each switch channel and is not a reboot. Home Assistant shows a channel as a light when the type is light, and as a switch otherwise. A profile is sent only to devices that list it, and only when you tick the box. The device reboots itself after a profile change. Nothing else in Shelly Installer reboots a device. This will update {count} devices, one at a time.

data.confirm_profile_reboot: Reboot these devices to apply the profile
data.set_site_default: Set all outputs to the site default

data_description.consumption_type: Applied to every switch channel that you have not set yourself. Leave unchanged to skip.
data_description.set_site_default: One step for devices already in Home Assistant, including ones added before Shelly Installer. Channels you set yourself are left alone. Does not reboot.
data_description.profile: Shown from Shelly.ListProfiles. Leave unchanged to skip. Switch and cover are typical on a 2PM.
data_description.confirm_profile_reboot: Required to change profile. The device reboots itself. Webhooks and schedules on that device are deleted by Shelly.

bulk_fields.title: Settings to change
bulk_fields.description: Every field starts unchanged. Only ticked fields are sent. Fields this group does not support are hidden.

error.invalid_timezone: Enter an IANA timezone name such as Australia/Melbourne, Australia/Sydney, or Europe/London. Abbreviations such as AEDT and offsets such as UTC+11 are not accepted.
error.invalid_brightness: Set both minimum and maximum brightness, with minimum lower than maximum.
error.invalid_night: Night mode needs a start and end in HH:MM.
error.not_found: That file is not in the config directory.
error.invalid_csv: The CSV could not be read. It needs a mac column.
error.outside_config: The path must stay inside the Home Assistant config directory.
error.already_listed: That MAC is already on the device list. Edit the CSV to change its name or room.
error.not_applied: The device did not keep this value. It was left as it is.
error.not_reachable: Shelly Installer could not open this device. Check that it is online.
error.confirm_profile: Tick the box to change profile. The device reboots itself. No other change reboots it.

ble_window_closed.title: Shelly setup window is closed
ble_window_closed.description: {name} ({mac}) is advertising, but Bluetooth RPC is not available. Power-cycle it within range of a connectable Bluetooth adapter. Factory-new Gen2, Gen3, and Gen4 devices accept provisioning for about 15 minutes after power-on (about 3 minutes for battery devices). After the first IP address there is a further grace period of about 5 minutes, then Bluetooth RPC and the open access point close.

apply_profile.name: Apply profile
apply_profile.description: Apply the Shelly Installer security and channel profile to Shelly devices already added by the core Shelly integration. Sets the device login only when a device has no password. Devices that already have a password are not changed, and Home Assistant keeps the password already stored for them.
